verdict.rationale: TaxJar's integrations page lists prebuilt connectors spanning commerce platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento 2, WooCommerce, eBay, Amazon FBA), payment processors (Stripe, PayPal, Square) and NetSuite, and its positioning targets businesses selling through these platforms, so the core of 'transactions feed in without building plumbing' is covered. Integration count is capped by plan (e.g. 'up to 10 total integrations'). missing for 10: dedicated subscription billing-system integrations (beyond Stripe), documentation of how each connector syncs transactions and how it is maintained, independent or hands-on corroboration of integration reliability.
